selection.ownership: DataForB2B, a France-based B2B data API founded 2022 (Tracxn). Product English docs and global API at api.dataforb2b.ai; founder Eliott Cerpaud. Distinct from DataForSEO (Estonia) and DATA FOR BUSINESS FRANCE SAS. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official DataForB2B API (api_key header, GET /account, POST /search/count, GET /typeahead), France-based operator evidence, and dated incident search (DataForB2B/dataforb2b.ai + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13 after excluding DataForSEO and generic B2B broker hits. No current unresolved DataForB2B platform compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

Pinned source and official docs agree on https://api.dataforb2b.ai with the api_key header. GET /account is the cheap authenticated credit-balance read. Marketing pages that mention /v1/people/search and Bearer auth disagree with current docs and pinned source; native follows docs. People/company search and enrich endpoints are billable and omitted. Count is documented as free. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved platform breach. Not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
